output.summary: A genus of annual, biennial or perennial herbs with a strikingly divided distribution across temperate parts of the Western Palaearctic and Southern Hemisphere. They favour wet ground, often marshes and salt marshes, and bear divided leaves with small white flowers in branching clusters. Some species are edible, notably wild celery, the ancestor of celery, celeriac and leaf celery.
